title: Proposal (one line of records/proposals.jsonl)
description: A proposed change to the organization. A proposal has no status field: its status is derived from decisions and signatures. With no signed decision it stays a proposal, and it is kept and committed like any other record.

kind.description: What the proposal changes, as a label. The check judges a decision by what it changes in the organization's files, whatever this says: a proposal of kind other whose decision switches a module on adopts structure.

target.description: What it changes: a module ID, a role ID, a rule ID, a tool ID, or a file path.

change.description: The change, stated so that someone else could carry it out.

why.description: The reason, in one or two sentences.

drawn_from.description: Optional. Where the idea came from, e.g. the founder's answer to an interview question.

supersedes.description: Optional. ID of an earlier proposal this one replaces.

background.description: Optional. What the founder needs to know to decide this, in plain words: the terms used, what the options mean, what is uncertain. Shown at the close-out with the decision.

if_undecided.description: Optional. What happens if nobody decides (the default).

cost_of_waiting.description: Optional. What waiting costs, if anything.

problem.description: Optional; asked of a proposal that changes structure (CORE-2). What fails or is missing today; point to a record if there is one.

expected_effect.description: Optional; asked of a proposal that changes structure. What ought to look different afterwards, put so that the records could show it.

grounding.description: Optional; asked of a proposal that changes structure. Its basis: a source, as an object (source: author, year and title; pages; status: read or lead; source_file: the saved copy under sources/, for a work marked read), or the words "our reasoning". Give a source only where there is one, and never make one up (CORE-13); the check warns when a work marked read has no saved copy.

for_the_founder.description: Optional; asked of a proposal that changes structure. One paragraph in everyday words for the founder: what changes for them, and at what cost. The check warns when a decision adopts structure from a proposal without it.

undo.description: Optional; asked of a proposal that changes structure. How to go back on the change; the records from the time it was in force are kept. The check warns when a decision adopts structure from a proposal without it.
